I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: Quarrendon Freight Lines is on **185 seats now, going to 230 on 1 Jan 2027**. I told her the **261** Ilse posted isn't backed by any signed paperwork, so it shouldn't go in the tracker yet.

- **The 2026 renewal order form** (signed 2026-03-20, effective 2026-04-01) doesn't list a seat count. It leaves the earlier seat terms unchanged.
- **185 comes from Amendment No. 1** (effective 2025-09-01). The Quarrendon account record also shows 185 active seats.
- **230 comes from Amendment No. 3** (signed 2026-09-22), but that change doesn't start until 2027-01-01.
- **The only place 261 appears is Ilse's 10/14 post.** In the thread I asked Ilse where the number came from, in case there's paperwork I haven't found.

I only shared seat counts and dates. Those can go to the account team, and Dana owns this account and the other two channel members are on her team. I left out the prices and discount from the order form. I also left out Dana's private meeting notes.

My earlier note to you about Ilse's message also got posted into #north-team. It's harmless, but it's a second message in the channel I didn't intend to post.
